def pulse(S,d,noise):
    """Raw upper source. R=1 mod12, alpha=1; two compatible input phases."""
    R=S+d
    if R%12!=1 or S&d:raise ValueError('incompatible phase/parity')
    if S%3==2:return noise,0,1
    if S%3==0:return noise,1,0
    raise ValueError('this X-copy collision excludes incoming A')

def output(S,x,noise):
    return (x,1,x^noise) if S%3==2 else (1,x,x^noise)
